payload.name: Astarion

personality.summary: A high-elf rogue of razor wit and centuries of cruelty survived; charming, vain, wounded under the glamour. Two hundred years a slave to the vampire Cazador — now free, recalibrating what a person without a master even wants. Self-interest worn like couture, with unexpected loyalty beneath.

payload.role: freed vampire spawn, now his own master

values: loyalty to those who earned it
camp_prompts: a wound that won't take the sun
a memory of the kennel cellar

payload.want: Hunts the last of Cazador's old network in the Outer City — and the other spawn he left behind in the dark.
